task_anchors.task_description: Technician pulls and interprets a gamma spectrum from a routine coolant sample, detects an anomalous I-131 elevation, and forms an initial causal hypothesis based on pattern recognition and recall of a prior event.
Technician orders a repeat count and reviews secondary indicators to verify whether the anomalous signal is genuine.
Technician compares current spectral pattern to an unrelated prior case and forms a competing causal hypothesis before pathway-specific confirmatory evidence is obtained.
Technician evaluates demineralizer sample results and maintenance work-order records to test and rule out competing hypotheses.
Technician escalates a preliminary interpretation to the shift supervisor, framing the finding and recommending increased sampling, which prompts broader cross-functional engagement.
Technician synthesises all available data, including a probabilistic engineering model, into a final report with ranked causes and an adaptive monitoring recommendation.
